# dsh-wsl-kit
**One line:** DeepSeek Harness agent in WSL, chat in a Windows browser — install this kit when paths
, proxy, clipboard, and “open that file” must cross the OS boundary.
This is a **meta-repo** (docs + install script + `cordis.patch.yml`). It does not ship plugin runtim
es. Each plugin repo ships a homepage `README.md` (often Chinese-first for newer plugins) plus `READ
ME.en.md` / `README.zh.md` as needed.
中文说明 → README.zh.md
## How the pieces fit
The kit is not a runtime. `install.sh` loads **Daily / GitHub / LLM / Full** plugins into the dsh `w
eb` profile. Chat stays on Windows; the agent and tools stay in WSL. A second tier of **Linux/local
capability** plugins (inference, search, media, read-only DevOps, …) is **not** in `install.sh` — us
e `link-linux-plugins.sh` or `dsh plugin add` as needed. IM / Obsidian / Jev are likewise off `insta
-linux-plugins.sh` or `dsh plugin add` as needed. IM / Obsidian / Jev are likewise off `install.sh`.

### The bundle package, and why `install.sh` is still the way in

There is a `package.json` here that describes the same 31 plugins as one bundle
(`dsh.bundle.patch`

→ `cordis.patch.yml`, which carries their `config`). **It does not install today**, and
the reason i
s worth knowing before you try it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
pnpm refuses a git-resolved dependency inside another git-resolved package. A `github:` bundle there

fore
cannot depend on `github:` plugins — so the bundle only becomes installable once the plugins ar

e **on npm**,
at which point its dependencies become ordinary version ranges.

Until then: **use `install.sh`** (or `dsh plugin add` per plugin). The `package.json` is the
descrip
tion of the destination, not a second route to it.
## Compatibility (2026-09)
| Piece | Status |
| **dsh** | Verified against **`0.2.2-rc.1`** (2026-11-05). rc.1 syncs Cordis Core 4.1.0, Loader 1.1
.0, and Include 1.1.0. The WSL plugin suite needs no source change: all 71 plugin `lib/` entry point
s import under rc.1, and the full `web` profile boots with every bundle enabled and no compatibility
errors. `dsh-experimental-tool-worktree` remains merged into change requests/worktrees; remove it f
rom profile bundles if present. Kit scripts assume dsh **≥0.1.2** UI launch tokens (`?token=` on `:3

081`). The `{{cwd}}` placeholder in dsh-wsl-env is gone. |
| **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash** | Official API
model id is **`deepseek-flash`**. Legacy `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` tempor
arily route to V4.1 Flash. **Not configured by this kit** — set under `llm-deepseek` / default model

in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`. |
| **Agent Teams** | Opt-in experimental package (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-exp
erimental-agent-team-profile`, same line as your dsh). **Not** part of `install.sh`. Expect longer “

Deep diving” turns; use a fresh non-Teams session to smoke-test models. |
| **Plugins** | Snapshot:
Plugin versions (sibling checkouts 2026-09-16). Floor: `scripts/check-plugin-versions.sh`. Daily inc
ludes dsh-wsl-fetch **≥0.1.1**. |
### Upgrading, and what keeps the UI reachable

Use `scripts/upgrade-dsh-full.sh`; it reads the target release's notes before it
installs anything,
and `docs/UPGRADE.zh.md` describes the layers and the traps.
Two scripts exist so a broken UI does not need a person at the keyboard:
| `scripts/dsh-web-watchdog.sh` | Probes the port on a timer and revives only when it is down; anyth

ing already answering is left alone |
| `scripts/dsh-rescue.sh` | Last resort. Assumes neither syste
md nor the rest of this kit is intact, falls back to starting dsh directly |
### What `restart-dsh-web.sh` loads

- `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`, `OLLAMA_API_KEY` default `ollama`
- `NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1,localhost` only (d
o **not** inherit Clash RFC1918 `NO_PROXY` globs — they make Node skip the proxy and timeout on `api

.deepseek.com`)
- Optional: `source "$HOME/.dsh/dsh-wsl-github.env"` yourself before start when usin
g GitHub App plugins

(system prompt inject) | dsh-wsl-env |
**Daily** = table above + `win_launch` + `dsh-repeat-stop` + `dsh-tool-budget` + **`dsh-wsl-fetch`**
*Daily** = table above + `win_launch` + `dsh-repeat-stop` + `dsh-tool-budget` + **`dsh-wsl-fetch`**.
Smoke: in a new session ask “run `net_doctor`” and “copy this path to the Windows clipboard”. Prefer
model **`deepseek-flash`** for cloud; keep Agent Teams off for first smoke.
## Security

- Plugins share your Harness permissions (files, network, Windows via PowerShell/`cmd`).
- `win_laun

ch` is allowlisted; `cred_hint` / GitHub App never dump secrets into chat.
- `win_notify` blocks on

a MessageBox — keep text short and secret-free.
- Keep `*.env` under `~/.dsh/` at `chmod 600`; never

ep text short and secret-free.
- Keep `*.env` under `~/.dsh/` at `chmod 600`; never commit API keys.
